item.title: Emre Yüksel - Homology representation of deck groups
item.description: Abstract Talk Our vector space will be a vector space over the complex field. (Which is a Algebraically closed field) We start with some definitions: Definition A G representation is a map G \to GL(\mathbb{V}) A subrepresentation is a space W \subseteq V that is G-invariant.

item.title: Jacob Skarby - Auslander Reiten theorem
item.description: Abstract Talk We recall the Auslander-Reiten quiver. Definition The Auslander-Reiten-quiver \Gamma_A for a given Algebra A has as vertices the representatives of indecomposable modules (called ind A) in modA.
